name: tlhunter/node-roguelike
description: A Node.js library for generating top-down 2D dungeon maps using BSP trees, room placement, and corridor carving with configurable parameters. Lightweight npm package for JavaScript roguelike and dungeon-crawler games.
score_rationale: Clean, dependency-free JavaScript dungeon generation library suitable for browser and server-side game projects.
summary: Node.js library for 2D dungeon generation using BSP trees and room placement algorithms.
